lastText: GQGCOMPTE RENDUHome19141915191619171918HARD MODE — EROSION 5/5-10MANPOWER-9MUNITIONS+5ARMY MORALEVI.1918The Chamber Reads the LedgerNo single offensive did this. There is a column of figures covering four years and a pattern in it: a command that answered every problem with an attack and went on answering after the attacks had stopped producing anything but the figures. In this Republic the army does not outlast the civil power's patience with it. That was settled a long time before this war and it is being demonstrated again now.Contested judgmentCommand in a republic is held on terms. The terms were always the casualty list.Return to file
